```{r}
# wrangle SAMHSA data about alcohol use disorder, mental illness, and major depressive episodes from the years 2015-2016, 2018-2019, 2021-2022, 2023-2024 
# Kylie and Jerry found data and planned wrangling steps, Leyna coded
```

```{r}
#| label: setup

# load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
#| label: data-wrangle-code
 
# Data import, `skip` to take out the initial lines that aren't actual data

dataset_list <- list(
  sud_15_16 = read_csv("../raw-data/15-16-substance-use.csv", skip = 6),
  dep_ep_15_16 = read_csv("../raw-data/15-16-depressive-ep.csv", skip = 6),
  m_illness_15_16 = read_csv("../raw-data/15-16-mental-illness.csv", skip = 5),
  
  sud_18_19 = read_csv("../raw-data/18-19-substance-use.csv", skip = 6),
  dep_ep_18_19 = read_csv("../raw-data/18-19-depressive-ep.csv", skip = 6),
  m_illness_18_19 = read_csv("../raw-data/18-19-mental-illness.csv", skip = 5),
  
  sud_21_22 = read_csv("../raw-data/21-22-substance-use.csv", skip = 6),
  dep_ep_21_22 = read_csv("../raw-data/21-22-depressive-ep.csv", skip = 6),
  m_illness_21_22 = read_csv("../raw-data/21-22-mental-illness.csv", skip = 5),
  
  sud_23_24 = read_csv("../raw-data/23-24-substance-use.csv", skip = 6),
  dep_ep_23_24 = read_csv("../raw-data/23-24-depressive-ep.csv", skip = 6),
  m_illness_23_24 = read_csv("../raw-data/23-24-mental-illness.csv", skip = 5)
  )


# Data wrangling

# vector of all unneeded columns to be deleted
trash_col <- c("12 or Older 95% CI (Lower)", "12 or Older 95% CI (Upper)",
               "12-17 95% CI (Lower)", "12-17 95% CI (Upper)",
               "18-25 95% CI (Lower)", "18-25 95% CI (Upper)",
               "26 or Older 95% CI (Lower)", "26 or Older 95% CI (Upper)",
               "18 or Older 95% CI (Lower)", "18 or Older 95% CI (Upper)",
               "95% CI (Lower)", "95% CI (Upper)", "18+ 95% CI (Lower)",
               "18+ 95% CI (Upper)", "26+ 95% CI (Lower)", "26+ 95% CI (Upper)",
               "18 or Older Estimate", "18+ Estimate", "12-17 Estimate",
               "12 or Older Estimate", "12+ Estimate", "12+ 95% CI (Upper)",
               "12+ 95% CI (Lower)")

dataset_list1 <- lapply(dataset_list, function(df) {
  # go through each dataset
  # remove "Order" column & keep "State" 
  df |> select(-"Order", 
               "State", 
            # remove any of the columns that match the ones listed in trash_col
               -any_of(trash_col))
})

# group datasets by year into lists
dataset_15_16 <- dataset_list1[1:3]
dataset_18_19 <- dataset_list1[4:6]
dataset_21_22 <- dataset_list1[7:9]
dataset_23_24 <- dataset_list1[10:12]

# add corresponding year to the end of variables in each dataset
# except for the state variable
# go through each dataset in the lists
dataset_15_16 <- map(dataset_15_16, ~ rename(.x, ))
dataset_15_16 <- lapply(dataset_15_16, function(df) {
  df |>
    rename_with(~ paste0(., " 15_16"), -"State") 
})

dataset_18_19 <- lapply(dataset_18_19, function(df) {
  df |>
    rename_with(~ paste0(., " 18_19"), -"State") 
})

dataset_21_22 <- lapply(dataset_21_22, function(df) {
  df |>
    rename_with(~ paste0(., " 21_22"), -"State") 
})

dataset_23_24 <- lapply(dataset_23_24, function(df) {
  df |>
    rename_with(~ paste0(., " 23_24"), -"State") 
})

list2env(c(dataset_15_16, dataset_18_19, dataset_21_22, dataset_23_24), 
         envir = .GlobalEnv)

# create new dataset that joins all datasets under the same topic
sud_all_yrs <- sud_15_16 |>
  left_join(sud_18_19) |>
  left_join(sud_21_22) |>
  left_join(sud_23_24)

dep_ep_all_yrs <- dep_ep_15_16 |>
  left_join(dep_ep_18_19) |>
  left_join(dep_ep_21_22) |>
  left_join(dep_ep_23_24)

m_illness_all_yrs <- m_illness_15_16 |>
  left_join(m_illness_18_19) |>
  left_join(m_illness_21_22) |>
  left_join(m_illness_23_24)

# clean up variable names
# replace "+", "_or_older", and "_plus" with "plus"
# replace "x" that appears in front of all variables with "age"
# remove "%" in data values and convert to numeric data type

sud_all_yrs <- sud_all_yrs |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "\\+", "plus")) |> 
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "_plus", "plus")) |> 
  clean_names() |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "_or_older", "plus")) |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "x", "age")) |>
  mutate(across(2:9, ~ as.numeric(gsub("%", "", .x))))

dep_ep_all_yrs <- dep_ep_all_yrs |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "\\+", "plus")) |> 
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "_plus", "plus")) |> 
  clean_names() |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "_or_older", "plus")) |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "x", "age")) |>
  mutate(across(2:9, ~ as.numeric(gsub("%", "", .x))))

m_illness_all_yrs <- m_illness_all_yrs |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "\\+", "plus")) |> 
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "_plus", "plus")) |> 
  clean_names() |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "_or_older", "plus")) |>
  rename_with(~ str_replace(.x, "x", "age")) |>
  mutate(across(2:9, ~ as.numeric(gsub("%", "", .x))))

sud_change <- sud_all_yrs |>
  mutate(
    precovid_age18_25 = age18_25_estimate_18_19 - age18_25_estimate_15_16,
    precovid_age26plus=  age26plus_estimate_18_19 - age26plus_estimate_15_16,
    covid_age18_25 = age18_25_estimate_21_22 - age18_25_estimate_18_19,
    covid_age26plus=  age26plus_estimate_21_22 - age18_25_estimate_18_19,
    postcovid_age18_25 = age18_25_estimate_23_24 - age18_25_estimate_21_22,
    postcovid_age26plus=  age26plus_estimate_23_24 - age26plus_estimate_21_22,
  ) |>
  select(state, precovid_age18_25, precovid_age26plus, covid_age18_25,
         covid_age26plus,postcovid_age18_25, postcovid_age26plus)

dep_ep_change <- dep_ep_all_yrs |>
  mutate(
    precovid_age18_25 = age18_25_estimate_18_19 - age18_25_estimate_15_16,
    precovid_age26plus=  age26plus_estimate_18_19 - age26plus_estimate_15_16,
    covid_age18_25 = age18_25_estimate_21_22 - age18_25_estimate_18_19,
    covid_age26plus=  age26plus_estimate_21_22 - age18_25_estimate_18_19,
    postcovid_age18_25 = age18_25_estimate_23_24 - age18_25_estimate_21_22,
    postcovid_age26plus=  age26plus_estimate_23_24 - age26plus_estimate_21_22,
  ) |>
  select(state, precovid_age18_25, precovid_age26plus, covid_age18_25,
         covid_age26plus,postcovid_age18_25, postcovid_age26plus)

m_illness_change <- m_illness_all_yrs |>
  mutate(
    precovid_age18_25 = age18_25_estimate_18_19 - age18_25_estimate_15_16,
    precovid_age26plus=  age26plus_estimate_18_19 - age26plus_estimate_15_16,
    covid_age18_25 = age18_25_estimate_21_22 - age18_25_estimate_18_19,
    covid_age26plus=  age26plus_estimate_21_22 - age18_25_estimate_18_19,
    postcovid_age18_25 = age18_25_estimate_23_24 - age18_25_estimate_21_22,
    postcovid_age26plus=  age26plus_estimate_23_24 - age26plus_estimate_21_22,
  ) |>
  select(state, precovid_age18_25, precovid_age26plus, covid_age18_25,
         covid_age26plus,postcovid_age18_25, postcovid_age26plus)

sud_change_long <- sud_change |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 2:7,
    names_to = "interval_age_group",
    values_to = "percent_change"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year_interval = case_when(
      (str_detect(interval_age_group, "precovid") == TRUE) ~ "precovid",
      (str_detect(interval_age_group, "postcovid") == TRUE) ~ "postcovid",
      .default = "covid"
    ),
    age = case_when(
      (str_detect(interval_age_group, "age18_25") == TRUE) ~ "18-25",
      (str_detect(interval_age_group, "age26plus") == TRUE) ~ "26+"
    )
  )

dep_ep_change_long <- dep_ep_change |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 2:7,
    names_to = "interval_age_group",
    values_to = "percent_change"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year_interval = case_when(
      (str_detect(interval_age_group, "precovid") == TRUE) ~ "precovid",
      (str_detect(interval_age_group, "postcovid") == TRUE) ~ "postcovid",
      .default = "covid"
    ),
    age = case_when(
      (str_detect(interval_age_group, "age18_25") == TRUE) ~ "18-25",
      (str_detect(interval_age_group, "age26plus") == TRUE) ~ "26+"
    )
  )

m_illness_change_long <- m_illness_change |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 2:7,
    names_to = "interval_age_group",
    values_to = "percent_change"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year_interval = case_when(
      (str_detect(interval_age_group, "precovid") == TRUE) ~ "precovid",
      (str_detect(interval_age_group, "postcovid") == TRUE) ~ "postcovid",
      .default = "covid"
    ),
    age = case_when(
      (str_detect(interval_age_group, "age18_25") == TRUE) ~ "18-25",
      (str_detect(interval_age_group, "age26plus") == TRUE) ~ "26+"
    )
  )

saveRDS(sud_change_long, file = "../data/sud.rds")
saveRDS(dep_ep_change_long, file = "../data/dep_ep.rds")
saveRDS(m_illness_change_long, file = "../data/m_illness.rds")

```
